connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — JERC (Goa & UTs) Order on True-up of FY2015-16 and MYT/ARR for 2nd Control Period, Petition No. 274/2019 (effective 01-06-2019), Ch.7 'Tariff Schedule', category 'Commercial': as currently published by the department at https://nec.andamannicobar.gov.in/assets/docs/tariff.pdf. This is the most recent tariff schedule found publicly listed by EDA&N (no later revision located). Fixed charge shown (₹30/connection/month) is the single-phase rate for the 0-500 unit slabs; a three-phase rate of ₹125/connection/month applies to the 501+ slab, not modelled here.

PRIMARY — JERC (Goa & UTs) Order, Petition No. 274/2019, Ch.7 'Tariff Schedule', category 'Industrial': https://nec.andamannicobar.gov.in/assets/docs/tariff.pdf. Fixed charge published as ₹50/kVA/month; treated here as Rs./kW.

PRIMARY — JERC (Goa & UTs) Order, Petition No. 274/2019, Ch.7 'Tariff Schedule', category 'Irrigation Pumps and Agriculture': https://nec.andamannicobar.gov.in/assets/docs/tariff.pdf. Fixed charge published as ₹50/kVA/month; treated here as Rs./kW.
